bio.text: Donna Mears has served in the Alaska House of Representatives for District 21 since 2023.
According to Mears's legislative biography, the representative has lived in Alaska for 27 years and holds a master of urban planning degree from the University of Michigan.

The biography lists positions including chair of the Anchorage Health and Human Services Commission and work for the Municipality of Anchorage solid waste services and the Alaska Native Tribal Health Consortium.
